bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/admin1/server-core
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 7fede271a9459b998935e1ae9995d7feba27d9c5
old=server-core-bounded-host
stage=server-core-bounded-host-stage-7fede271
img=gace-server-core-bounded-host:hostsha-7fede271
! docker inspect "$stage" >/dev/null 2>&1
docker image inspect "$img" >/dev/null
trap 'docker rm -f "$stage" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
docker run -d --name "$stage" --network gace-internal --init --user 1000:1000 --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --pids-limit 64 --memory 192m --tmpfs /tmp:size=32m,mode=1777 --volumes-from "$old":ro --env-file <(docker inspect -f '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' "$old") "$img" >/dev/null
sleep 4
docker exec "$stage" python3 -c 'import urllib.request; assert urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8789/healthz",timeout=3).status==200'
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$stage")" = true
printf 'RECEIVER_STAGE_HEALTH_PASS\n'
